title: No label overlaps another on pid's plots
body:
## What exists today

pid draws `pid.pdf`, `roc.pdf`, `time.pdf` and `cells.pdf` through the scripts under `benchmarks/pid/scripts/`.

## The change

The labels on every pid plot overlap each other. Fix them so none overlap.
close_reason: e6ceee4 moved the labels on pid's identity, ROC and runtime plots. Jack confirmed that none overlap.
